autoRecode.title: Automatic Recode
autoRecode.note: Each distinct value is assigned a sequential integer starting from 1. Value labels are created automatically.

countValues.title: Count Values within Cases
countValues.note: Counts how many of the selected variables equal the specified value for each case.

weightCases.title: Weight Cases
weightCases.scopeNote: Weighting is applied in Frequencies, Descriptives, Explore, Means, Crosstabs, the T-Tests, and One-Way ANOVA. Analyses outside this scope show a "weight not applied" warning in the Output.

splitFile.title: Split File
splitFile.off: Analyze all cases, do not create groups
splitFile.scopeNote: Analyses that support it repeat their tables for each group; analyses that don't show a "split not applied" warning in the Output.

sortCases.title: Sort Cases
sortCases.noKeys: Click a variable to add it as a sort key

aggregate.title: Aggregate Data
aggregate.noBreakVars: No break variables (single overall summary row)
aggregate.noSummaryVars: Add at least one summary variable
aggregate.newDatasetNote: Creates a new dataset with one row per Break Variable group (SPSS "Create a new dataset" mode). The current dataset is not modified.

transpose.title: Transpose
transpose.newDatasetNote: Creates a new dataset where each case becomes a variable and each (numeric) variable becomes a case. String variables are skipped.

defineVarProps.title: Define Variable Properties
defineVarProps.scanNote: Scans up to {{cap}} distinct values per variable and suggests labels/missing-value definitions. Variables with more distinct values are treated as continuous (Scale) with no per-value editing.
defineVarProps.tooMany: {{count}} distinct values — treated as continuous, no per-value editing.
defineVarProps.label: Label

restructure.title: Restructure — Variables to Cases
restructure.newDatasetNote: Creates a new dataset: each row of the active dataset becomes one row per Value Variable (index = position in the list above), Id Variables are replicated. Value Variables are cast to the first one's type.

mergeAddCases.title: Merge Files — Add Cases
mergeAddCases.newDatasetNote: Creates a new dataset stacking the second file's cases below the active dataset's. Variables are matched by name; unmatched variables are added with missing values on the side that didn't have them.

mergeAddVariables.title: Merge Files — Add Variables
mergeAddVariables.newDatasetNote: Creates a new dataset joining the second file's variables onto the active dataset by the key variables (every case in the active dataset is kept). Colliding variable names from the second file are renamed (e.g. "age_2").

identifyDuplicates.title: Identify Duplicate Cases
identifyDuplicates.note: Cases are compared in their current row order (no automatic re-sort). The first case in each matching group is marked as primary (1); later cases in the group are marked 0.
